estimates.assumptions: Directly using the supplied measurement of 750g for the lamb as the edible mass. No estimation needed for grams; caloriesPer100g left null per instructions as it is not a supplied known value and we do not estimate it.

A large onion is typically 150g when chopped (standard culinary estimate for a large peeled onion weighing ~110-200g); using midpoint as realistic edible mass. Copying supplied knownCaloriesPer100g exactly.

A medium-large whole lemon (as used for wedges) weighs ~65g including peel (edible portion after juicing/wedges is similar in mass context); standard average for one lemon. Copying supplied knownCaloriesPer100g exactly.
